name: LWSABAH
recent: Life Water Berhad 近期完成以 RM46.8 million 收购三家沙巴公司 90% 股权，并以 RM15 million 收购 KKIP 工业区土地及办公楼。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 18 日召开第三届年度股东大会。最新财报显示 2026 财年第四季度营收与净利均实现环比和同比增长。
notable: 完成以 RM46.8 million 收购 Hung On Thong Mini Supermarket、Hung Tai Enterprise (Sabah) 及 Kilang Mee Ban Soon 各 90% 股权。
以 RM15 million 现金收购 KKIP 工业区一宗土地及附带办公楼和车间。
董事 Tan Hwong Kuen 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日出售 93,100 股普通股。
risks: 董事 Tan Hwong Kuen 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日出售 93,100 股普通股。
独立非执行董事 Selma Enolil Binti Mustapha Khalil 于 2026 年 9 月 8 日出售 40,000 股普通股。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度营收为 RM57.0 million，环比增长 17.5%，同比增长 28.0%；净利为 RM10.95 million，环比增长 36.1%，同比增长 21.0%；净利率为 19.2%，高于上一季度的 16.6%。

recent_en: Life Water Berhad recently completed the acquisition of a 90% equity interest in three Sabah companies for RM46.8 million and acquired land and an office complex in KKIP for RM15 million. The latest financial results show both revenue and net profit grew quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year in 4Q FY2026.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of a 90% equity interest in Hung On Thong Mini Supermarket, Hung Tai Enterprise (Sabah) and Kilang Mee Ban Soon for RM46.8 million.
Acquired a parcel of land with an office complex and ancillary workshop in KKIP for RM15 million cash.
Director Tan Hwong Kuen disposed of 93,100 ordinary shares on 7 September 2026.
risks_en: Director Tan Hwong Kuen disposed of 93,100 ordinary shares on 7 September 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Selma Enolil Binti Mustapha Khalil disposed of 40,000 ordinary shares on 8 September 2026.
earnings_en: 4Q FY2026 revenue was RM57.0 million, up 17.5% QoQ and 28.0% YoY; net profit was RM10.95 million, up 36.1% QoQ and 21.0% YoY; net margin was 19.2%, higher than 16.6% in the previous quarter.
